title: Birch Memorial Clock Tower

terrainReference.basis: Bilinear sample from the original Terrarium field adjoining the tower platform.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named tower node 4540711689 and adjacent Dato Sagor plaza line
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap tower node 4540711689 fixes the position, and the adjacent plaza line fixes the local directions. The square base and orientation of architectural faces are reconstructed from the image and plaza plan.

note: Estimated proportions from the single cleared exterior photo, with a 1.9812 m main bell as an interior scale control. The base follows the untouched plaza terrain. Shared plaster and painted trim reproduce the strong pale-and-dark clock tiers.
